claims.assertion: Anéeka said local Viera authorities opposed events on Earth but lacked authority to intervene; she suspected higher Federation levels might coordinate with deeper groups.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She said the extent of coordination was uncertain.

claims.assertion: Anéeka said Federation ships monitor Earth and sometimes attack regressive craft, but do not liberate humanity.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She framed this as preserving the Matrix.

claims.assertion: Anéeka said Federation-authorized lunar traffic could support equipment or operations; she placed more SSP activity around Mars.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She doubted lunar traffic was SSP.

review_flags: Claims about hidden Federation coordination and space programs are attributed to Anéeka and are not independently evidenced in the transcript.
